author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Struggling to type React components correctly? This TypeScript React tutorial walks you through using TypeScript in real React projects, from typing useState to building reusable typed components, with hands-on challenges throughout.

✏️ Study this course interactively on Scrimba: https://scrimba.com/learn-typescript-c03c?via=scrimbafcc
Code is available on the Scrimba course page for each lesson.

TypeScript makes React code safer and more predictable. In this module, you'll learn how to type useState, component props, JSX elements, and function props through practical lessons. Perfect for developers who know React basics and want to add TypeScript to their workflow.
This isn't just a watch-and-learn tutorial. You'll complete real coding challenges, including building the AriaLiveStatus and WordLetters components from scratch.
